strengths.item: The paper is generally well organized, with a clear progression from motivation and related work to architecture, training/inference optimizations, experiments, appendices, and conclusion.
The PDF follows standard ICLR formatting with readable body text, consistent section typography, page numbers, and no obvious rendering, cropping, or margin problems on inspected pages.

Mathematical notation and equations are visually well aligned and consistently numbered, and the main architectural and algorithmic components are supported by equations, algorithms, tables, and figures.
Figure and table captions are mostly informative and usually explain the purpose of the corresponding visual evidence.

weaknesses.item: The presentation is visually dense, especially on pages 6–8, where multiple tables, paragraphs, algorithms, and figures are packed closely together, making quick inspection harder.
Several figures and tables are small or cramped: Figure 1 has small internal labels, Figures 2–4 have small axis labels, tick labels, and legends, and Tables 3–8 are densely arranged on one page.
Some layout choices reduce readability, such as Figure 1 placed beside narrow text on page 4, crowded bottom content on page 6, and three figure groups compressed onto page 8.
There are minor formatting issues, such as a missing space in “MMLU(Hendrycks...” on page 8.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The paper map indicates a coherent structure: introduction, related work, architecture, training/inference systems, experiments, benchmarks, appendix, and conclusion. PDF inspection found that pages 1–8 use recognizable ICLR formatting and are generally readable. Equations and algorithms are consistently formatted, and captions for figures and tables are mostly explanatory. However, visual inspection also found several dense pages: page 4 has a cramped figure/text layout, page 6 is crowded with algorithms and tables, page 7 packs many small tables together, and page 8 contains multiple small plots with small labels and legends.
dimension_review.rationale: The paper is understandable and reasonably polished, with clear sectioning and enough visual and mathematical support for reviewers to follow the method and results. The main presentation limitation is not fundamental unreadability but reviewability: several important tables and plots are compressed, with small labels and crowded page layouts. These issues are noticeable but do not prevent comprehension, so the presentation is good rather than excellent.
